decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display is a flexible core format that is cheap to keep in the catalog, though it was not visible on the website in 2020 to 2021.
The pegboard-back display meets ongoing demand for hanging-product promotions and fits existing production, despite its recent lack of web visibility.
The standard quarter-pallet display is a staple retail format with steady brand demand.
The eighth-pallet display rounds out the pallet-size range at little extra cost.
The wooden pallet departs from the cardboard core and its absence from the website hints at weak traction, but it still adds range for some customers.
Physical media sales kept shrinking through 2020 to 2022, so a dedicated media display is better folded into the generic quarter-pallet offer.
